emulate.command: n=0; while [ ! -f dist/apps/ghreactions-functions/main.js ] && [ $n -lt 120 ]; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); done; [ -f dist/apps/ghreactions-functions/main.js ] || { echo 'No build after 120s: check the watch output above'; exit 1; }; cp apps/ghreactions-functions/.secret.local dist/apps/ghreactions-functions/ && npm exec firebase-tools -- emulators:start --only functions,firestore --project ghreactionsdev

shell.command: test -f dist/apps/ghreactions-functions/main.js || { echo 'No build found: run npm run emulate:ghreactions-functions first'; exit 1; }; cp apps/ghreactions-functions/.secret.local dist/apps/ghreactions-functions/ && npm exec firebase-tools -- functions:shell --project ghreactionsdev
